lessons.claim: An occupancy ratio read from a trajectory with exponentially distributed residence times has an error 2.8x larger than the within-run visit-count estimate, because the total time in a well is carried by a few long visits. Measured over 10 seeds of a dual optical trap: within-run 0.232 (7.8 percent) against a seed-to-seed sd of 0.654 (22.2 percent). Two single runs read 3.29 and 3.39 against an exact answer of 2.9515 and the gap was reported as a 12 percent discrepancy in the simulation; with 10 seeds the mean is 2.9535 +- 0.2070, i.e. 0.0 sigma. Measuring such a ratio to 5 percent needs 16x the observation time a naive hop-count estimate suggests.
